title: Changed Warehouse Account, how can i move previous amounts/stock from old account to the new one?

posts.cooked: Hi there, I recently had to change the warehouse account of some of my warehouse. However, I already had some stock transactions done through the old account. How can I find the amount and transfer it to the new warehouse account? Thanks

I had the same situation, here is what I did.

  • Before changing the account on the warehouse:

    • Create a Stock Reconciliation
    • Fetch all stock from the warehouse
    • Export the Items child table to csv
    • Create a copy of the csv (to keep original quantities), and set all qty=0 in the new csv.
    • Now back to the Stock Reconciliation, empty the Items table, and load the csv with qty=0.
    • Submit

  • After changing the account on the warehouse:

    • Create a Stock Reconciliation
    • Load the csv with the original quantities
    • Submit
